name: research-paper-workflow
description: Evidence-grounded orchestration for quantitative research papers, from idea discovery through reproducible delivery.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate ideas, literature, research design, theory, empirical evidence, simulation, writing, independent review, revision, and reproducible delivery without overstating incomplete evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $research-paper-workflow to resume this paper from its current artifacts.
Use $research-paper-workflow to turn this research direction into testable candidate ideas.
Use $research-paper-workflow to audit what still blocks a reproducible paper release.
